sentences.text:
Jyotsna Mitra Hazra @ Jyotsna Hazra vs The State Of West
Bengal & Ors on 9 June, 2023

Author: Rajasekhar Mantha
Bench: Rajasekhar Mantha
09.06.2023
Court No.13
Item No.322
Ap
 Wpa 19690 of 2022
 Jyotsna Mitra Hazra @ Jyotsna Hazra
 Vs.
 The State of West Bengal & Ors.
 Mr. D. Chakraborty
 Mr. Sk. Sujauddin
 ...

Ms. Sipra Majumdar
 Ms. Prativa Ghatak
 ...

1. 
The petitioner is aggrieved that the order of the Sub-
Divisional Magistrate dated 8th January, 2021 passed in Case No.119 of 2021 has not been complied
with by the Maheshtala Police Station.

2. Learned counsel for the State has produced a report in the form of instructions issued by the
Inspector-in- Charge, Maheshtala Police Station addressed to the learned Government Pleader and
the same is taken on record.
3. The report states that Subhankar Mitra is not traceable by the Maheshtala Police Station.
4.  The petitioner shall visit Maheshtala Police Station and, if necessary, accompany the police officials to her marital house to identify her husband.

5. For the aforesaid purpose the petitioner shall visit the Maheshtala Police Station on 12th June,
2023 at 2 pm.
